environment: project .venv, torch 2.11.0+cu126, Transformers 4.57.6, RTX3090 24GiB, FP16 model, FP32 attention reference, TF32 off
preprocessing: reuse frozen shared Hadamard-sign, per-channel calibration mean and scale; no new local runtime normalization

new_methods.TCN_MinMax: BitLadder equal-width floor quantizer, interval midpoint reconstruction, calibrated per-layer/head/side extrema
new_methods.TCN_Clipped: same encoding with calibration-only range optimization for average D2,D3,D4
new_methods.Residual211: QuantSpec-inspired unsigned 2bit RTN base + symmetric 1bit residual + symmetric 1bit residual; shared per-head amplitudes fitted to clipped calibration residual E|e|
new_methods.LogResidual211: Lynx-inspired signed alpha-law companding followed by Residual211 in companded coordinates; inverse companding at each depth; not native Lynx split-stream mapping

new_codec_objective: mean standardized-domain MSE across 2,3,4 bits, evaluated with deployed FP16 parameters and tables; residual amplitudes fit sequentially
statistical_unit: request; average layers, positions, heads and seeds inside request; request-paired bootstrap 2000 samples, 95% CI
metadata: charge actual FP16 arrays used by each reference decoder; include all 2/3/4bit reconstruction tables; stored payload and read payload reported separately

controller_after_encoding.fixed_codec: Jacobian_Tree: original D-K output-Jacobian tree and original D-V attention tree, not JacK_MixV
controller_after_encoding.policy_inputs: current Q + frozen per-channel physical MSE curves; then reconstructed-K attention + frozen V curves

online_pilot.selection: first and last test request of each of six datasets in frozen manifest order

controller_after_encoding.performance_claim: reference implementation overhead only; no serving speed or HBM traffic claim

failure_policy: any failed numerical, baseline, trajectory or completeness gate stops all subsequent stages
data_status: exploratory reuse of existing test data; no new independent quality confirmation
